name: Model calls vs cap
description:
Shows: Heatmap of model_calls per agent and the daily maximum of calls_ratio (model_calls / reserved_calls; 1.0 means the run used its whole reservation). Reads run.finished.
Why it matters: Shows whether call budgets are sized right. Runs pinned at 1.0 are cut off before finishing (wasted work); runs far below their reservation hold quota other agents could use.
